note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified; the substituted datum is supplied by the author and only its dependent geometry changes. Nothing is inferred about validity, responsibility or outcome.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional guest-pass rule. The supplied route datum 'Sent by Route A' is replaced by 'Sent by Route B': the lens on the shuttle valve shows the ball crossing to the other seat and the glow moving to tube B; the capsule stays in the same tray; the old datum is kept on a struck slip.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional library-fee rule; the lens opens on the receiving TRAY instead of the valve, and the datum goes the other way — from Route B (desk note) to Route A (night-slot log). The capsule stays in the tray; only the ball and the route glow follow the new datum.

rules.name: Library rule 9 (fictional text): a late fee may be looked at again by either route
conditions: The book was returned through the night slot
A staff member recorded a desk extension

facts.label: Night-slot log shows the book at 23:10 on Day 14
Desk note: extension recorded by staff member R. Osei

issues: Which clock does the night-slot log use?
assumptions: Both documents are taken as supplied
params.beforeValue: Sent by Route B — desk note about an extension
params.afterValue: Sent by Route A — night-slot log for Day 14

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names and texts near the field limits: long rule caption, conditions, facts, before/after values, context caption, marker, assumptions and issue. Text wraps between words; sizes stay at or above 16 px at 1080p.

rules.name: Rule M-27 (fictional housing co-operative rule): a request to use the shared roof terrace may arrive by either route
conditions: The request is countersigned by two registered members of the housing co-operative board
The requester presents the stamped annual terrace permit issued by the caretaker's office

facts.label: Request form countersigned by board members Maria-Fernanda Castellanos and Oluwaseun Adeyemi-Clarke on Day 12
Annual terrace permit no. T-5561 stamped by the caretaker's office, shown at the stairwell door on Day 13

issues: Were both countersignatures added before the request was placed in the tube? (not examined here)
assumptions: Each route is read on its own and neither route is ranked above the other
The dates are taken from the documents as supplied; none of them is verified here
params.beforeValue: Sent by Route A — the countersigned request form of the housing co-operative board
params.afterValue: Sent by Route B — a copy of the stamped annual terrace permit no. T-5561

presets.name: baseline-es
presets.description: Versión en español del ejemplo base: el dato de ruta aportado 'Enviado por la ruta A' se sustituye por 'Enviado por la ruta B'; la lupa sobre la válvula muestra la bola pasando al otro asiento.

rules.name: Regla G-2 (regla ficticia de un club): la solicitud de pase de invitado puede llegar por cualquiera de dos rutas
conditions: Un socio invita por escrito a la persona invitada
La persona invitada muestra una tarjeta de un club asociado

facts.label: Nota de invitación firmada por el socio J. Park el día 3
Tarjeta del club asociado n.º 0417 mostrada en la puerta

issues: ¿Sigue vigente la tarjeta n.º 0417? (no se examina aquí)
assumptions: Cada ruta se lee por separado; los hechos se toman según lo aportado
params.beforeValue: Enviado por la ruta A — nota de invitación del socio J. Park
params.afterValue: Enviado por la ruta B — tarjeta de club asociado n.º 0417
